strings.site.tagline: Artist-accurate MIDI, generated onto the track you are already working on.
strings.site.description: Freally MIDI Master — a CLAP/VST3/AU plugin that generates original artist-style MIDI onto the track you are already working on, in your project's own key and tempo. Free today, offline, and 100% AI-free.
